maya: Quick FYI — I spotted a couple broken anchors in the FAQ after the handbook restructure. Also the Docker snippet on the deploy section still uses an old env var.

sam: Which page exactly? can you paste the anchor/link?

maya: It’s /handbook/faq#deploy — the hash lands at the top not the deploy section. The snippet currently shows:
```bash
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY="$KEY" redwood/inference:latest
```
I think the runtime env was renamed to REDWOOD_API_TOKEN. Also would prefer we standardize anchors to `faq-deploy` style slugs.

oliver: I can take this. Opening a draft PR to update the snippet and normalize anchors, plus add redirects for the old hashes so external links don't break.

tess: pinging @docs-owners — can someone verify the redirect plan? we want minimal churn for external shortlinks (and search).

maya: thanks. when you do the PR can you add a quick staging smoke test step that checks the anchor resolves?

sam: fyi on redirects: prefer 301 for public shortlinks, and keep an internal rewrite for legacy/internal shortlink forms.

oliver: noted, will add 301 mapping and an internal rewrite rule in the nginx mapping file. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1023 — description: "FAQ: normalize deploy anchor + update docker snippet + add redirect mappings". I also added a tiny changelog entry. Demo deploy queued.

maya: :thumbsup: i'll smoke test once staging is up.
